title: Do You Hide a Secret Snack Stash?
description: Discover your snacking personality and resource hoarding style.

questions.text: You buy your favorite limited-edition snack. What happens next?

choices.label: Hidden in the deepest corner of my closet.
Stored neatly for future late-night cravings.
Eaten immediately in my room with the door locked.
Left on the kitchen table for anyone to grab.

questions.text: A roommate or family member asks for a bite of your food.

choices.label: Absolutely not. Get your own.
I’ll give them a specific, calculated piece.
I pretend I didn't hear them and eat faster.
Sure, take half!

questions.text: Where is your primary snack inventory?

choices.label: Dispersed in secret, locked locations.
A designated, organized emergency drawer.
Hidden in my bag or pockets right now.
The main fridge or pantry.

questions.text: How do you feel when someone touches your food without asking?

choices.label: Furious. It's an act of war.
Annoyed. It messes up my inventory plan.
Sneaky. Next time, I'll hide it better.
Fine. Food is meant to be shared.
"What's mine is strictly mine."
"Always be prepared for a snack emergency."
"Eat fast, leave no evidence."
"Sharing is caring!"
